# netbox_vlan_translation_rule (Resource)

From the [official documentation](https://docs.netbox.dev/en/stable/models/ipam/vlantranslationrule/):

> A VLAN translation rule maps a local VLAN ID to a remote VLAN ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "netbox_vlan_translation_rule" "example" {
  policy_id  = netbox_vlan_translation_policy.example.id
  local_vid  = 100
  remote_vid = 200
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `local_vid` (Number) Numeric VLAN ID (1-4094).
- `policy_id` (Number) The ID of the policy associated with the vlan translation rule.
- `remote_vid` (Number) Numeric VLAN ID (1-4094).

### Optional

- `custom_fields` (Map of String) Custom field values of the object, as a map of field name to value.
- `description` (String) A description of the vlan translation rule.
- `tags` (Set of String) Tags assigned to the object, by name.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `tags_all` (Set of String) All tags assigned to the object, including those not managed by Terraform.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The ID is the numeric NetBox ID of the object
terraform import netbox_vlan_translation_rule.example 1
```
